findings.issue: Manual-match approval contract still contradicts A16. A16's approval action code for this decision is deposit.manual_match (rows AUTO and 4E), and its suspense.resolve row always needs an approval id: the AUTO path carries an AUTO id issued by A14's service path. A17 queries A14's resolver and creates requests under action code suspense.resolve, asks A14.x for suspense.resolve rows, and says TRSY may resolve an exact below-threshold receipt 'without an approval id'; a challenge expects it to post 'with no request'. Against the real A16 every manual match fails with LDG_APPROVAL_MISMATCH (wrong action code) and the direct path fails with LDG_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
findings.fix: Use A16's action code deposit.manual_match for the resolver query, the A14 request and the A14.x precondition (AUTO when amount_cents lt 1000000 and the match is exact by name and reference; otherwise 4E TRSY -> CFO). Keep suspense.return as its own code. Have the exact below-threshold path obtain an AUTO approval id from A14's service path and pass it to suspense.resolve. Rewrite the lines that say 'without an approval id' or 'with no request' to 'with an AUTO approval id and no human checker'.

findings.issue: Agent refusals on the two person-only routes use the wrong code. A12 says an agent calling a requiresHuman route gets 403 AGNT_NOT_ALLOWED, with G22_SCOPE_NON_DELEGABLE only as a reason code. A12's verify step check-agent-refusal-codes fails any test that expects G22_SCOPE_NON_DELEGABLE as the code of an x-realx-requires-human operation. A17's nominated-account text and its D04 challenge expect 403 G22_SCOPE_NON_DELEGABLE on POST /v1/payments/nominated-account and POST /v1/payments/payto-mandates, so the oracles would fail verify.
findings.fix: Expect 403 AGNT_NOT_ALLOWED with gate G22 and reason code G22_SCOPE_NON_DELEGABLE on both routes. Keep SCOPE_NON_DELEGABLE for refusals at token issue.

findings.issue: The payout primitive's funding and outcome rows do not match A16. (a) The refund purpose has no funding row in A16: order.refund moves offer_escrow to investor_cash, and A39 pays a refund to the bank as a withdrawal (origin refund_return_to_bank). A17 says refunds are drawn through withdrawal.pay under the refund batch's approval, but withdrawal.pay needs a withdrawal.release approval on withdrawal:<id>. (b) createPayout checks the funding journal only for distribution and return_to_payer. For withdrawal and escrow_settlement it never requires that the purpose's payout_clearing journal (withdrawal.pay, escrow.release or escrow.settlement_resend) has posted under the same approval for the same amount. It never states amount equality either, so a bank payout could leave with no ledger debit. (c) A16 uses payout.settle, payout.failed and payout.returned for every purpose except withdrawal, and its purpose names are suspense_return and distribution_bank. A17 posts withdrawal.settle for distribution, return_to_payer and escrow_settlement, and asks A16.x for failure rows that already exist. (d) escrow_settlement accepts only the 6E escrow.release id, so A16's 4E escrow.settlement_resend after a returned settlement is refused. (e) A16 already has deposit.unmatched_returned; A17 lists deposit.returned_unmatched as a row still to add and uses that name in invariant 2 and the challenges.
findings.fix: Remove the refund purpose, or define it as A39's withdrawal with origin refund_return_to_bank. For every purpose, require that the A16 funding journal to payout_clearing (line payout:<id>) has posted under the named approval id for exactly amount_cents; refuse otherwise with PAYOUT_NOT_FUNDED. Use A16's withdrawal.* rows for withdrawal and payout.settle, payout.failed and payout.returned for every other purpose, with A16's purpose names. Accept escrow.settlement_resend (4E) as the approval for a resent escrow settlement. Rename the recall row to deposit.unmatched_returned and remove it and the payout failure rows from the A16.x preconditions.

findings.issue: Money-out and receipt paths that other specs expect from A17 are missing. There are no payout purposes for withholding_remit (A41: A16's withholding.remit posts to payout_clearing, and 'the bank fact from A17' settles it), rounding_sweep, fee_sweep (A39's A17.1) or the shortfall top-up from operating (A16 posts on A17's confirmation, but A17's internal_transfer refuses realx-operating). There is no receipt class for trustee credits on offer-escrow (A39's A17.1). Today such a credit posts deposit.unmatched on the hold, and A39's own escrow journal on the match would count the bank mirror twice.
findings.fix: Add those purposes now with their destination, G02 subject and approval rules, or list an A17.1 follow-up in Preconditions naming each purpose and receipt class and its caller (A39, A41). State that an unknown purpose is refused with PAYOUT_PURPOSE_UNKNOWN. State that the offer-escrow trustee-credit match resolves the existing suspense line rather than posting a second bank-mirror leg.

findings.issue: The spec requires a GateEvaluation through A19 for every payout purpose and for PayID issuance, but A19 has no action kind for them. A19's ActionKind list has withdrawal, distribution_line and deposit_credit only, with no PayID issuance, return_to_payer, escrow_settlement or internal_transfer, and startup fails for an evaluator a kind does not list. The parameter is also misnamed: it is aml.screening_max_age_h in A19's table 1a, not screening_max_age_h in table 1b.
findings.fix: Add an A19.x precondition for the kinds payid_issue and payout (with a purpose field) or one kind per purpose, with the G01, G02 and G14 subjects for payer and trustee entity, and mark the dependent oracle cases blocked until it lands. Correct the parameter name and table reference.

findings.issue: Provider registrars are still not agreed across specs. A40's spec says A40 registers DistributionFundingProvider through A17's index.ts, although the graph has no A40 -> A17 edge; A17 says A49 registers it. A42's spec never mentions InvestorFactsProvider, RestrictionProvider or AmlClearanceProvider, and has no receipt-clearance decision. A39's spec does not mention OperatingReceiptSink. A17 sends these to 'Skipped items in the node's evidence' instead of Preconditions. The start-up check fires only when 'the registering node's registrar is present', so a registrar that was never written leaves the fake bound silently until A49. A40 also fixes the run reference as DST-<yyyymmdd>-<6 base32>, but A17's challenge uses RUN-....
findings.fix: List A42.x (three providers plus a clearance decision for receipts), A39.x (OperatingReceiptSink) and A40 plus an A40 -> A17 graph edge (DistributionFundingProvider) as named follow-ups under Preconditions. Make the binding check compare against a static expected-registrar table keyed by node and milestone, not against registrar presence. Change the challenge reference to the DST-... form.

findings.issue: The seed contract still conflicts with A06. A06's load(generate(baseline)) writes the double-entry ledger itself, with bank feed lines matched to every ledger entry. A17 has reset(seed) replay the seeded day's 96 NPP credits and the AML lines through ingestTransaction, which would post deposit.matched and deposit.unmatched a second time. A17 also loads opening balances from bank-balances.json and then adds those lines, yet expects state() to equal bank-balances.json after reset. A06 describes that file as the client-money balances (3 accounts), while A17 loads 4.
findings.fix: State one rule. For example: bank-balances.json holds closing balances for all four accounts after the seeded lines; reset loads opening = closing minus the seeded lines, then replays them; and A06 writes no ledger journal for any line A17 replays (A06.x follow-up). Assert state() == bank-balances.json only after the replay.

findings.issue: The Sev1 re-raise at five NSW business days reuses dedupKey payments.held:<bankTxnId>. A13 increments occurrences on the open alert with that key, so no Sev1 alert appears. A13 also spells the field dedup_key.
findings.fix: Use a separate key such as payments.held.sev1:<bankTxnId>, or A13's severity-escalation call if it has one, and use A13's field spelling.

findings.issue: The ONB-09 design field shows the account number as '••••4471' (four dots). The spec says GET /v1/payments/payids/me returns '••4471' 'so A56 renders the step without transformation'. The '••4471' form is the design's 'CBA ••4471' used on the wallet and in withdrawals.
findings.fix: Return a masked last-4 plus bank_label and state both display forms (ONB-09 '••••4471', wallet and withdrawals 'CBA ••4471'), or have A56 own the formatting.
